name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '20' is the chapter-ID domain value (chapters 01-30 are meaningful IDs), confirmed by dispatch-table index 19 at 0x51B19 (0x51B65-0x51B19=0x4C, /4 = 19 -> chapter 20). It is NOT an address remnant (the function sits at 0x20957, not 0x20). Name accurately describes the chapter-20 turn-cycle post-action handler.
purpose: Chapter 20 turn-cycle post-action handler: large multi-faction battle win/lose decision dispatched from the per-chapter post-action handler table.
logic_summary: Calls default fd2_check_battle_end_condition, then layers three stages writing data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0x53ECC). Stage 1 (LOSE+dialog): scan NPC group runtime_char[0x35..0x3C] (loop i=0x26..0x2D, slot i+0xF); loop does not early-exit, sets some_alive on any live slot; if all dead set code=1 and show current_chapter_text page 10. Stage 2 (LOSE): if hero runtime_char[0] OR boss-ally runtime_char[0x34] dead, set code=1 (OR short-circuits). Stage 3 (WIN): reset some_alive, scan enemy union runtime_char[0x24..0x33] (i=0x15..0x24) and runtime_char[0x3D..0x52] (i=0x2E..0x43); if all dead set code=2. Stage 3 runs last so a full enemy wipe overrides an earlier LOSE (win-overrides-loss).

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Unused dispatch-artifact argument. Body does (void)event_arg. In the binary it is the Watcom __CHK-prologue artifact (function consumes no real incoming stack arg; epilogue is bare ADD ESP,4 / POP EBX / RET with no caller-side arg cleanup). Ghidra mislabels it 'chapter_id'; 'event_arg' is the consistent convention across all sibling post-action handlers in this file.
params.reason: Conventional, accurate name for the ignored dispatch-artifact parameter shared by the whole post-action handler family; not an address remnant and not misleading. No rename warranted.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is writing data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code (0=continue, 1=lose/game-over, 2=win).

writes_globals: data_fd2_chapter_event_or_battle_end_code @ 0x53ECC (set to 1 in Stage 1/Stage 2, set to 2 in Stage 3)
notes: Disassembly verified line-by-line against chpost.c source: prologue PUSH 0x30/CALL __CHK(0x36cd7); callees fd2_check_battle_end_condition(0x205be), fd2_check_char_is_dead(0x3453e), fd2_display_dialog_scene(0x15f84); dialog page 0xA=10 with geometry 0xA0000/0x140/0xCD/0x4C/0x4A/0x13/blink=1; current_chapter_text read from 0x53A79. Dispatch xref confirmed at 0x51B65 (table 0x51B19 index 19 = chapter 20). Source comment is accurate, precise, ASCII-clean, no process/phase narration -> kept verbatim; chpost.c not modified.
